reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin that provides agent-accessible image understanding, OCR, UI analysis, debugging, and image description through configurable external vision model providers.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供可供智能体调用的图像理解工具，支持 OCR、界面分析、调试和图像描述，并可配置多个视觉模型提供商。
summaries.en: Provides DSH agents with an image-understanding tool for OCR, UI analysis, debugging, and image description through configurable vision model providers.

capabilities: Registers an image_understand tool for agent use
Accepts local image paths, HTTP(S) URLs, and data URIs
Preprocesses images with compression and multi-cropping
Sends image data and prompts to configured external vision model providers
Uses API keys and configurable provider endpoints
